content.title: Serve Robotics CEO talks DoorDash partnership, tariff impacts
content.description:
DoorDash (DASH) and Serve Robotics (SERV) are teaming up to expand the food delivery robots. Serve Robotics co-founder and CEO Ali Kashani joins Market Domination to discuss the DoorDash partnership, delivery robot competition, the startup's growth, regional expansion plans, and how the company is mitigating tariffs.
